title: Which humanoid robot will win the opening-day 100-metre race at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing?

  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-22
  • Accepted Answer Format: String (robot name). Resolve to the humanoid robot reported as the winner of the opening-day 100-metre race.

title: Which driver will take pole position for the inaugural Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, DC?

title: Which Republican U.S. Senate candidate will be reported by August 25, 2026, to have asked AIPAC not to campaign on their behalf?
background: The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) is a pro-Israel lobbying organization active in congressional elections. Its political support has historically extended to candidates from both major U.S. parties. The next midterm elections are scheduled for November 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reporting by established news organizations published by August 25, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in the November 2026 election reported to have requested that AIPAC not run a campaign on their behalf. A request conveyed through the candidate's campaign allies qualifies; merely criticizing AIPAC does not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The candidate's first and last name.
last_rationale: AIPAC joint fundraiser w/ Collins caused backlash (May 2026)

title: Who will win Nottingham Forest's opening Premier League match of the 2026–27 season?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official Premier League result for Nottingham Forest's first league fixture of the 2026–27 season.
  • Resolution: Resolve according to the result at full time, including stoppage time. Preseason and cup fixtures do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning club's name, or “Draw” if the match finishes level.

title: Which club will win Manchester United's opening match of the 2026–27 Premier League season?
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution: Resolve according to the full-time result of Manchester United's opening Premier League fixture, scheduled for August 22, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Return the winning club's name. If the match finishes level, return “Draw”.

title: Who will win the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia Diamond League meeting?
background: The 400m hurdles is a one-lap track race in which athletes clear hurdles in assigned lanes.
resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.

title: Who will win the women's 100m at the 2026 Silesia Diamond League meeting?
background: The Diamond League is an annual series of elite international athletics meetings.
resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the women's 100m at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.

title: Who will win the women's singles title at the 2026 Cincinnati Open?
background: The Cincinnati Open is a major professional hard-court tennis tournament held in the lead-up to the US Open.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Cincinnati Open results or reputable contemporary reporting of the completed women's singles final.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the champion of the 2026 women's singles tournament is confirmed following the final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning player's full name.

title: Who will win the men's singles title at the 2026 Cincinnati Open?
background: The Cincinnati Open is an ATP Masters 1000 hard-court tournament held ahead of the US Open.
resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Cincinnati Open or ATP results for the 2026 men's singles tournament. Resolution occurs when the final is completed and the champion is confirmed. The answer must be the winning player's full name.

title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Dutch Grand Prix?
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the driver officially classified as the winner of the Grand Prix's main race, rather than a qualifying session or sprint race.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning driver's full name.

title: Which country will host USS Abraham Lincoln's next port call after August 1, 2026?
background: USS Abraham Lincoln is a US Navy aircraft carrier on an extended deployment involving operations in the Middle East.
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country containing the first port at which USS Abraham Lincoln makes a confirmed port call after August 1, 2026. Transit through territorial waters without a port call does not qualify.

title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?

resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose public broadcaster announces during August 2026 that it will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, citing concerns about the contest's political neutrality.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

title: Who will win the PFA Men's Players' Player of the Year award for the 2025–26 season?

resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution: Resolve when the winner is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning player's full name.

title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
resolution_criteria:

  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The competition's standard name.

title: If Novak Djokovic and Aryna Sabalenka play mixed doubles together at the 2026 US Open, which pair, if any, will eliminate them?
background: The US Open mixed doubles tournament is a knockout competition featuring teams consisting of one male player and one female player.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official US Open match results, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the opposing pair that defeats Djokovic and Sabalenka in a completed match, eliminating them from the 2026 US Open mixed doubles tournament. If they do not compete together, withdraw without a completed defeat, or win the tournament, no pair qualifies.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Both opposing players' surnames, joined by “and”; either order is acceptable.

title: Which senior Trump administration official will CBS News report as visiting Moscow in August 2026?
background: The United States has pursued diplomatic engagement with Russia concerning the war in Ukraine.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: CBS News reporting published during August 2026 identifying a senior Trump administration official as visiting Moscow.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the official explicitly named in that reporting as being in Moscow, rather than merely considering or planning a visit. The question concerns the identity reported by CBS News; independent verification or government confirmation of the visit is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The official's full name.

title: Which U.S. state will report the country's first measles death of 2026?
background: Measles can cause fatal complications, and state health departments monitor and report deaths associated with the disease.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official state health department announcements, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting from reliable news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the state that publicly reports a measles death among its residents occurring in calendar year 2026 and identified as the first reported U.S. measles fatality of that year. Resolution occurs when that announcement is made.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the U.S. state.
